name: Walt Palmer Supply, Inc.
old_description: Walt Palmer Supply, Inc. is a family owned company serving Utah supply houses, contractors, and homeowners since 1958. We are a second-generation family ownership and are highly dedicated to providing only the finest quality products.
about:
Walt Palmer Supply, Inc. was founded in 1958 in Salt Lake City, Utah, as a family-owned business. Now in its second generation of family ownership, the company has served Utah supply houses, contractors, and homeowners for over six decades.

The company operates a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility producing sheet metal components for HVAC, plumbing, and roofing applications. Its product lines include square and round HVAC duct, water heater pans and venting for plumbing, and roof jacks, flashings, curbs, and caps for roofing. Custom design and fabrication services are also offered to meet specific project requirements.

Walt Palmer Supply primarily serves the HVAC, plumbing, and roofing sectors within the construction industry. Its customer base consists of Utah-based supply houses, mechanical and roofing contractors, and residential homeowners seeking replacement parts or custom solutions.

The company emphasizes its commitment to quality, on-time delivery, and efficiency, rooted in a tradition of family ownership since 1958. It differentiates itself through its manufacturing capabilities, custom design flexibility, and long-standing relationships with local trade professionals.
